arguments.content:
import ast

mods = ["mod_cache", "mod_core", "mod_io", "mod_math", "mod_text"]
lines = ["CONTRACTS = {"]
for m in mods:
    tree = ast.parse(open(m + ".py", encoding="utf-8").read())
    lines.append('    "%s": {' % m)
    for node in tree.body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)):
            args = [a.arg for a in node.args.posonlyargs + node.args.args + node.args.kwonlyargs]
            lines.append('        "%s": %r,' % (node.name, args))
    lines.append("    },")
lines.append("}")

with open("contracts.py", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")
print("written")

arguments.content:
from contracts import CONTRACTS as C
import inspect, importlib

ok = True
for m, fns in C.items():
    mod = importlib.import_module(m)
    for fn, args in fns.items():
        real = [p.name for p in inspect.signature(getattr(mod, fn)).parameters.values()]
        if real != args:
            ok = False
            print("MISMATCH", m, fn, args, real)

with open("_check_out.txt", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write("modules: %s\n" % sorted(C))
    f.write("all match: %s\n" % ok)
